quelle: docs/RECHT.md of repairinfo.app (primary sources read on 13 October 2026): Directive (EU) 2024/825, Delegated Regulations (EU) 2023/1669 and 2025/1353, the ecodesign regulations named per group, Directive (EU) 2024/1799 as amended by Delegated Directive (EU) 2026/74, Article L. 541-9-2 Code de l’environnement and the French ministry’s category lists (8 July 2025).
hinweis: pflicht: 'nr20' = repairability score (Art. 6(1)(u) Directive 2011/83/EU, Art. 246a § 1(1) No. 20 EGBGB); 'nr21' = repair information where the producer makes it available (Art. 6(1)(v), No. 21). Ecodesign periods are minimum periods for manufacturers, importers and authorised representatives, not consumer rights. The French indices are national and not EU repairability scores. Not legal advice.
